notes: Reader: /root/reader_a; GPT-6 Astra Pro; effort not exposed; run SP84_C13_149. Scan 024 only. No external research, OCR, TeX compilation, or mathematical proof checking was performed.

Layout: one handwritten text sheet; heading, corollary statement, items a and b, three oblique marginal notes, and the beginning of a proof. No separate diagram or drawing is present. Thin bottom-left foliation reads 23; scan metadata is 24.

Reading count: 57 physical lines/rows inspected: 21 title and main baselines, 9 separate interlinear addition rows, 9 rows in the upper-left note, 8 in the lower-left note, 9 in the right note including its struck tail, and one folio row. Whole source and each prepared half were viewed once; all 22 saved detail crops were personally read.

S024.1 (transcribed claim, not checked): the corollary begins with two morphisms f,g whose displayed fundamental-group maps are equal as exterior homomorphisms. Item a describes an inserted map of Y into a commutative algebraic group and a translation parameter. The source says a in Y; it is not changed to G. The i:Y-to-G endpoint remains uncertain between shaft and arrow. The lower inserted row has un groupe, without the previously supplied en; its terminal G remains resolved.

S024.2 (transcribed claim, not checked): item b concerns an elementary variety/name and a short, partly uncertain fibration phrase followed by courbes anabéliennes. The condition on X and dominance is inserted before alors f=g. Normal is legibly cancelled and replaced by irred without a stop; possible parentheses immediately enclosing that short replacement remain doubtful. The terminal hook after dominant belongs to the attachment leader, so no independent comma or separate opening parenthesis before et si is supplied.

The upper-left note begins Ce cas n’est prouvé qu’en, differing from C’s est / par nous. Its double-underlined b) is separate. A long oblique stroke traverses several independent rows and ends within the note, supporting cancellation, but does not individually cross the lowest rows. The outer unsure around deleted qualifies that paragraph-level scope, not a claim that every lower letter carries a strike. Local masked words and the p>0 formula remain doubtful.

The lower-left note is live and separate from the upper cancellation. Its opening Une conjecture forte établirait l'unicité des morphismes and avec X irréductible are readable. After et, tentative quels plus one unreadable tiny group is retained, without expanding que soient les. Applications f,g remains. The sans/faut and dominantes/dominant ending remain local doubts. Dark retracing follows the last word's letters without an independent continuous strike, so that word is not deleted. A separate forked k/K-shaped glyph and a stop follow it. Root accepted this addition after its own crop inspection and the documented post-comparison consultation; the consultation is not an independent reading.

S024.3 (transcribed claim, not checked): the right note states a homology equality condition involving H_1 and Z_ell, followed by a prime-to-characteristic phrase and a heavily struck short tail. The Z signs have a second diagonal return supporting the witnesses’ double-stroke rendering; no alphabet normalization was made merely from agreement.

S024.4 (transcribed proof opening, not checked): the proof discusses uniqueness of a, replaces cancelled il with l'existence, and adds remplaçant Y par G et before en choisissant. The cancelled cluster before H_1 retains f_1, pi_1 and f as alternatives within one unresolved overwritten unit; no correction chronology is invented. The final ell condition remains attached after the equality and reads à car. without a separate la. The page ends after a dash and doubtful i.e./ici followed by il suffit.

Quotation marks are paired pen ticks, rendered as two backticks and two apostrophes. The long insertion leaders near sur un, the item-a group, before alors, and before en choisissant are not textual parentheses. Only the small possible enclosure immediately around irred remains qualified. H's editorial observations about the preceding page remain excluded from the source fragment.

No cross-page source comparisons were made. All local resolutions rely on this leaf and its packet notation snapshot. Any confidence-only changes are recorded in decisions/doubts rather than counted as substantive changes.

Root approved the first transcription after personally inspecting c01–c22 and reviewing every change, mark decision, doubt, inventory element and audit box. The paragraph-level marginal cancellation remains explicitly doubtful.

Independent audit: root personally inspected all 22 differing boxes and directed these adopted readings. Six boxes change: b07, b08, b09, b10, b12 and b21; b08/b09/b10 overlap the same condition insertion and are not three independent textual corrections. The substantive new source changes remove en and a comma and add the terminal k/K glyph; the enclosure and pi alternatives localize uncertainty without new certainty-only witness counts. Reader A serialized root's saved directive without a new visual reading. Frozen first/second readings and comparison inputs remain intact.
